identification: Antique/vintage oak hinged canteen-style box (cutlery box, interior blue lining) with engraved brass plaque 'To Mrs Charles McFerran on the occasion of her marriage 15-11-24', used as a sewing box and containing wooden cotton reels, ribbon/lace, paste/rhinestone buttons, a gold-tone Art Deco style belt buckle, a tin, two or three pairs of scissors and misc buttons. Common-value mixed sewing job lot; the box itself is an empty-canteen type worth roughly $35-120.
